subject.title: fix(ci): persist warm runtime caches across runs

question: Should this cache topology be required to demonstrate a controlled write followed by a later independent restore before merge, rather than relying on the proposed post-land validation?
rationale: The targeted failure depends on Blacksmith snapshot visibility and Actions cache behavior that guard tests and static workflow checks cannot establish; the maintainer must set the acceptable rollout proof for this protected CI change.

options.title: Require pre-merge restore proof
options.body: Split out the iOS edits and attach redacted warmer plus later-run logs showing the expected cache marker was restored.

options.title: Accept post-land validation
options.body: Merge with an explicit rollback plan and validate the writer/reader sequence only after the cache topology is live.

recommendation.title: Require pre-merge restore proof
recommendation.body: Split out the iOS edits and attach redacted warmer plus later-run logs showing the expected cache marker was restored.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior merged CI cache-maintenance change and this follow-up branch place the cache topology decision closest to this contributor’s recent area history.
